title: Measurement of GRI Porosity for Shale Sample
author: Fangwen Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.icycaxw
materials: Crush the shale sample into 80-200 mesh.

steps.title: Preheat shale sample
steps.instruction: Preheat a 250g shale sample in a vacuum oven at 100 °C for 12-16 hours to remove pore fluids (e.g., water and oil).

steps.title: Determine bulk density
steps.instruction: Measure the weight and bulk volume of the shale sample to calculate the bulk density (ρ b).

substeps.instruction: Measure bulk volume of the sample

steps.title: Determine grain density
steps.instruction: Measure the weight and grain volume of the shale sample to calculate the grain density (ρ g).

substeps.instruction: Measure grain volume of the sample

steps.title: Calculate GRI porosity
steps.instruction: Calculate the GRI porosity (Ф GRI) of the sample using the formula: Ф GRI = ( ρ g - ρ b )/ ρ g ×100%.
